nodes.title: Vector Basics, Direction Cosines & Ratios
points: Position vector: r = x î + y ĵ + z k̂, magnitude |r| = √(x² + y² + z²). Unit vector r̂ = r / |r|.
Direction angles α, β, γ: angles vector makes with positive X, Y, Z axes.
Direction Cosines (l, m, n): l = cosα, m = cosβ, n = cosγ.
Master Identity: l² + m² + n² = 1 ⟹ sin²α + sin²β + sin²γ = 2.
Direction Ratios (a, b, c): numbers proportional to direction cosines: l = a/√(a²+b²+c²), m = b/√(a²+b²+c²), n = c/√(a²+b²+c²).

formulas.label: Unit vector
formulas.expr: r̂ = (x î + y ĵ + z k̂) / √(x² + y² + z²)

nodes.title: Section Formula & Centroid Theorems
points: Internal Division: Point R(r) dividing AB in ratio m : n internally: r = (m b + n a) / (m + n).
External Division: Point R(r) dividing AB in ratio m : n externally: r = (m b − n a) / (m − n).
Midpoint Formula: m = (a + b) / 2.
Centroid of Triangle: g = (a + b + c) / 3.
Incentre of Triangle: i = (a a + b b + c c) / (a + b + c), where a, b, c are lengths of sides opposite A, B, C.
Centroid of Tetrahedron: g = (a + b + c + d) / 4.

nodes.title: Collinearity & Coplanarity of Vectors
points: Collinear Vectors: Two non-zero vectors a and b are collinear if and only if a = k b (components proportional: a₁/b₁ = a₂/b₂ = a₃/b₃).
Three points A, B, C are collinear if and only if AB = k BC.
Coplanar Vectors: Three vectors a, b, c are coplanar if one can be expressed as linear combination of the other two: a = x b + y c.
Determinant condition for coplanarity: [a b c] = 0 (Scalar Triple Product = 0).
Four points A, B, C, D are coplanar if and only if [AB AC AD] = 0.

nodes.title: Dot (Scalar) Product & Projections
points: Definition: a · b = |a| |b| cosθ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃.
Angle between vectors: cosθ = (a · b) / (|a| |b|).
Perpendicular (Orthogonal) Condition: a · b = 0 ⟹ a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃ = 0.
Scalar Projection of a on b: p = (a · b) / |b|.
Vector Projection of a on b: p_vec = [(a · b) / |b|²] b.
Work done by force F in displacement d: W = F · d.

formulas.label: Dot product
formulas.expr: a · b = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃ = |a| |b| cosθ

formulas.label: Scalar projection of a on b

nodes.title: Cross (Vector) Product & Geometric Areas
points: Definition: a × b = |a| |b| sinθ n̂, where n̂ is unit normal vector given by right-hand rule.
Determinant form: a × b = det [[î, ĵ, k̂], [a₁, a₂, a₃], [b₁, b₂, b₃]].
Non-commutative: a × b = −(b × a). Parallel condition: a × b = 0.
Unit vector perpendicular to both a and b: n̂ = ± (a × b) / |a × b|.
Area of Parallelogram: (1) With adjacent sides a and b: Area = |a × b|; (2) With diagonals d₁ and d₂: Area = ½ |d₁ × d₂|.
Area of Triangle ABC: Area = ½ |AB × AC|.
Moment of Force (Torque): τ = r × F.

formulas.label: Cross product determinant
formulas.expr: a × b = det [[î, ĵ, k̂], [a₁, a₂, a₃], [b₁, b₂, b₃]]

nodes.title: Scalar Triple Product (Box Product)
points: Definition: [a b c] = a · (b × c) = det [[a₁, a₂, a₃], [b₁, b₂, b₃], [c₁, c₂, c₃]].
Cyclic Permutation Invariant: [a b c] = [b c a] = [c a b].
Anti-cyclic change reverses sign: [a b c] = −[b a c] = −[a c b].
If any two vectors are equal or parallel: [a a b] = 0.
Volume of Parallelepiped with coterminous edges a, b, c: V = |[a b c]|.
Volume of Tetrahedron with coterminous edges a, b, c: V = (1/6) |[a b c]|.

formulas.label: Box product determinant
formulas.expr: [a b c] = det [[a₁, a₂, a₃], [b₁, b₂, b₃], [c₁, c₂, c₃]]

nodes.title: Vector Triple Product & Identities
points: Definition: a × (b × c) = (a · c) b − (a · b) c ('BAC − CAB' rule).
Lie in the plane of b and c, and perpendicular to a.
Non-associative: a × (b × c) ≠ (a × b) × c in general.
(a × b) × c = (a · c) b − (b · c) a.
Jacobi's Identity: a × (b × c) + b × (c × a) + c × (a × b) = 0.

formulas.label: BAC-CAB identity
formulas.expr: a × (b × c) = (a · c) b − (a · b) c

nodes.title: Vector Geometry Applications
points: Medians of a triangle are concurrent (intersect at centroid G, dividing each median in ratio 2 : 1).
Altitudes of a triangle are concurrent (intersect at orthocentre H).
Perpendicular bisectors of sides of a triangle are concurrent (intersect at circumcentre O).
Euler Line: Centroid G divides segment joining circumcentre O and orthocentre H in ratio 1 : 2 (OG : GH = 1 : 2).
Angle in a semicircle is a right angle (proved using dot product: r₁ · r₂ = 0).
Diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular to each other.

nodes.title: Must-Know Board Theorems & Vector Proofs
points: Board Favourite #1: Prove vector Section Formula for internal division: r = (m b + n a)/(m + n).
Board Favourite #2: Prove that medians of a triangle are concurrent using vector method.
Board Favourite #3: Prove by vector method: cos(A − B) = cosA cosB + sinA sinB.
Board Favourite #4: Prove Apollonius Theorem using vectors: |AB|² + |AC|² = 2(|AM|² + |BM|²).
Board Favourite #5: Prove that the angle subtended by a diameter on a semicircle is a right angle using vectors.

nodes.title: MHT-CET Shortcuts, Lagrange's Identity & Triple Hacks
points: Lagrange's Identity: |a × b|² = |a|² |b|² − (a · b)² ⟹ |a × b|² + (a · b)² = |a|² |b|².
Collinear Sum Vector Trick: If a + b + c = 0, then a × b = b × c = c × a.
Box Product Sum Shortcut: [a + b, b + c, c + a] = 2 [a b c].
Cross Product Box Shortcut: [a × b, b × c, c × a] = [a b c]².
Perpendicular Magnitude Shortcut: If |a + b| = |a − b|, then a ⊥ b (a · b = 0).
Unit Vector Equilateral Trick: If â, b̂, ĉ are unit vectors such that â + b̂ + ĉ = 0, then â · b̂ + b̂ · ĉ + ĉ · â = −3/2.

formulas.label: Box sum shortcut
formulas.expr: [a + b, b + c, c + a] = 2 [a b c]

formulas.label: Box cross shortcut
formulas.expr: [a × b, b × c, c × a] = [a b c]²
